buildfile_busy: Working on the Build Planner file.
buildfile_failed: The file was not written ({detail}). Check that your Documents folder can be written to and that the game is not blocking the file, then try again.
buildfile_folder_tip:
Opens the game's Build Planner folder in Explorer:
Documents\My Games\Path of Exile 2\BuildPlanner.
buildfile_help:
Path of Exile 2 has its own Build Planner: it shows builds from files in
Documents\My Games\Path of Exile 2\BuildPlanner right in the game.
The plugin can write the stage you follow as such a file.
It keeps working when a game patch stops the overlay hints for a while.
buildfile_intro: Writes the stage you follow into the game's own Build Planner, where the game shows it without POEFixer. Experimental.
buildfile_keep_tip:
Writes the file again whenever the stage you follow changes,
for example after a level-up moves you to the next stage.
Only the plugin's own file is ever written.
buildfile_none: No file has been written yet.
buildfile_remove_failed: The file was not removed ({detail}). Close the game's Build Planner window and try again, or delete the file in the folder yourself.
buildfile_remove_tip:
Deletes the file the plugin wrote and turns "Keep it updated" off.
Other files in the folder are never touched.
buildfile_write_tip:
Writes the passives, skills and items of the stage you follow
as one file named after the build.
Open the Build Planner in the game to see it.
buildfile_written: Written: {file}. Open the Build Planner in the game to see it.
builds_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? Its trees, skills and items are removed from the plugin. The link or code it came from can be imported again.
builds_delete_tip: Deletes this build from the plugin.
builds_facts: Imported {date}. Trees: {trees}, skill sets: {skills}, gear sets: {gear}.
builds_file_newer: Your saved builds were written by a newer version of Build Planner, so this version does not read them. Update the plugin in the Plugin Manager to get them back. If you import a build now, the plugin renames the newer file to builds.json.newer.
builds_file_unusable: The file with your saved builds (config\builds.json in the plugin's folder) could not be read, so the list starts empty. The file is not lost: at the next save the plugin renames it to builds.json.corrupt. Import your builds again.
builds_help:
Every build you imported.
Click a build to follow it: its hints show in the game at once.
The pen renames a build, the bin deletes it.
builds_none_selected: No build is followed. Click one to see its hints in the game.
builds_rename_refused: The name was not saved: it is empty or too long. Type another name and press Enter.
builds_rename_tip:
Renames this build.
Press Enter to save, Esc to keep the old name.
char_problem_bad_list: The character's passive list could not be read correctly. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
char_problem_bad_values: The character's level and passive points read as impossible values. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
char_problem_level: The character's level does not match what POEFixer reads. Open the passive tree once; if this stays, update POEFixer and the plugin.
char_problem_no_data: The passive tree data is not loaded yet, so the character's passives cannot be checked. Wait a moment or reinstall the plugin.
char_problem_no_object: The character's passives were not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
char_problem_no_player: The character's data was not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
char_problem_no_ui: The game's interface could not be read. Log in with a character; if this stays, restart POEFixer.
char_problem_not_in_game: Log in with a character to compare its passives with the build.
char_problem_read: Reading the character's passives failed, probably while an area was loading. It is tried again automatically.
char_problem_unknown_ids: The character has passives the plugin's tree data does not know. Open the Diagnostics card and press Update tree data.
common_busy: Another task is running. Wait until it has finished.
common_no_build: No build is followed. Import a build on the Builds tab, or click one of your saved builds there.
data_load_failed: The plugin's data could not be loaded ({detail}). Reinstall Build Planner from the Plugin Manager.
diag_copy_tip:
Copies what the plugin sees to the clipboard.
Paste it into your message when you ask for help.
diag_game_demo: Demo: a recording stands in for the game.
diag_game_incompatible: This POEFixer version is too old for Build Planner: the game cannot be read. Update POEFixer.
diag_gear_found: {slots} equipment slots found; the items in them are known.
diag_gear_found_no_items: {slots} equipment slots found. Open your inventory once so the plugin can see what you wear.
diag_in_game: Game: a character is in an area.
diag_not_attached: Game: Path of Exile 2 is not running, or POEFixer has not found it yet.
diag_not_in_game: Game: no character is in an area.
diag_offsets_builtin: The plugin's built-in values are in use.
diag_offsets_config: Values from your own file config\offsets.json: {n}. Delete that file to go back to the plugin's values.
diag_offsets_shipped: The values shipped with the plugin are in use.
diag_skills_found_closed: Skills with their support gems: {skills}. The Skills window is closed.
diag_skills_found_missing: Skills with their support gems: {skills}. The Skills window was not found yet: open it once.
diag_skills_found_open: Skills with their support gems: {skills}. The Skills window is open.
diag_tip:
What the plugin sees of the game and of its own data.
Open it when a hint is missing.
diag_tree_bundled: Bundled with the plugin: version {version}, {nodes} passives.
diag_tree_downloaded: Downloaded from Path of Building: version {version}, {nodes} passives.
diag_tree_fits: The data fits the game: the tree's passives were recognized ({coverage}%).
diag_tree_found_closed: Passives recognized: {nodes} ({coverage}%). The tree is closed.
diag_tree_found_open: Passives recognized: {nodes} ({coverage}%). The tree is open.
diag_tree_loading: The passive tree data is loading.
diag_tree_missing: Passive tree data is not loaded.
diag_update_tree_tip:
Downloads the newest passive tree data from Path of Building's page on GitHub.
Use it after a game patch changed the tree, or when the plugin says
its data does not match the game.
Nothing about you or your build is sent.
diag_use_bundled_tip:
Deletes the downloaded tree data and goes back
to the data that came with the plugin.
display_adjust_tip:
An orange ring on passives you have, but with another weapon set
or another attribute than the build uses.
display_ascendancy_tip:
Rings and step numbers on the ascendancy passives too.
They are numbered on their own, from the ascendancy's start.
display_attr_badges_tip:
A small S, D or I on "+5 to any Attribute" passives:
the attribute the build chooses there (Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence).
display_card_opacity_tip:
How solid the background of every box drawn over the game is:
the tree summary, the tooltips, the build item card and the skill cards.
display_color_adjust_tip: Passives you have with another weapon set or attribute than the build.
display_color_missing_tip: Passives the build has and you do not.
display_color_ok_tip:
Passives you have that the build has too.
Only drawn when "Mark passives already taken" is on.
display_color_reset_tip: Puts this colour back to the plugin's own.
display_color_wrong_tip: Passives you have that the build does not use.
display_colors_help:
The colours of the rings on the passive tree.
Click a colour to change it; the bar on the right of the picker
sets how see-through it is.
display_curved_tip:
Draws lines along the arcs of the tree, as the game does.
Off: every line is straight (a little faster to read on a zoomed-out tree).
display_gear_card_tip:
With the inventory open, pointing at an equipment slot shows the item
the build has for that slot, beside the game's own tooltip.
display_gear_help: Hints on the equipment slots of the inventory window.
display_line_width_tip:
How thick the lines between the build's passives
and the outlines of the rings around them are.
0 draws hairlines and the thinnest rings.
display_lines_tip:
Lines along the path between the build's passives that still matter,
so the route shows on a zoomed-out tree.
display_missing_skills_tip:
With the Skills window open, lists the build's skills
your character does not have at all, beside the window.
display_numbers_tip:
How many of the next points get their step number (1 = take this first).
0 hides the numbers; the rings stay.
display_ok_tip:
A dim ring on passives you already have and the build has too.
Off by default: it fills the tree with rings.
display_reset_confirm: Put every setting of this tab back to the plugin's defaults? Your builds, the stage you follow and the hotkey stay as they are.
display_reset_tip: Puts every toggle, slider and colour of this tab back to its default.
display_ring_scale_tip:
The size of the rings compared with the passive they mark.
1.00 fits the passive's own circle.
display_set_badges_tip:
A small I or II on passives the build takes with
Weapon Set I or Weapon Set II points.
display_show_tree: Show the build on the passive tree
display_show_tree_tip:
Turns every hint on the passive tree on or off.
The options below only matter while this is on.
display_skill_marks_tip:
With the Skills window open: a tick, an arrow or a cross on every
support gem of a skill, and beside the skill what to add.
Tick: in the build. Arrow: the build uses another tier.
Cross: not in the build.
display_skills_help: Hints on the game's Skills window, and the plugin's own Build skills window.
display_slot_marks_tip:
A small mark in the corner of every slot the build has an item for.
Green tick: you wear the build's item. Amber dot: another item, or nothing.
display_summary_tip:
A box at the top left of the tree: the build and stage,
how many points to take and refund, and the next objective.
display_tooltip_tip:
Pointing at a ring shows what to do with that passive,
the objective it leads to and the build author's note.
It opens below the passive; the game's own tooltip stays above it.
display_tree_help: What the plugin draws on the game's passive tree while it is open.
display_window_hotkey_tip:
A key that shows or hides the Build skills window while you play.
Click, then press the key. Clear removes it.
display_window_mode_tip:
The plugin's own window with the build's skills and their support gems.
Only when I open it: with the key below, or with the button under it.
With the game's Skills window: it opens and closes with that window.
Always: it stays open, also outside the game.
The key and the button work whatever is chosen here.
display_window_toggle_tip:
Shows or hides the Build skills window right now,
whatever is chosen above.
Needs a build that is followed.
display_wrong_tip: A red ring on passives you have that the build does not use.
gear_equipped_nothing: You wear nothing in this slot.
gear_equipped_unknown: The plugin has not seen what you wear here yet.
gear_help:
The items of the gear set you follow, slot by slot,
compared with what your character wears.
Click a row to see the item's mods.
A unique item must be the same unique.
Any other item is compared by its base type: "Same base" means
your item has the base type of the build's, whatever its name and mods are.
gear_no_mods: The build lists no mods for this item.
gear_no_set: This build has no gear set. Add items in Path of Building and import the build again.
gear_not_in_game: Log in with a character to compare the gear with what it wears.
gear_open_inventory: Open your inventory in the game once so the plugin can see what you wear.
gear_other_help:
Items of the gear set that have no equipment slot in the inventory window:
jewels in the passive tree and other special slots.
Click a row to see the item's mods.
gear_problem_no_panel: The inventory window was not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
gear_problem_no_slots: The equipment slots were not recognized. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
gear_problem_not_in_game: Log in with a character to compare its equipment with the build.
gear_problem_read: Reading the equipment failed, probably while an area was loading. It is tried again automatically.
gear_row_hint: Click a row to see the item's mods.
gear_set_empty: This gear set has no item for any equipment slot.
gear_summary: Slots that hold the build's item, or one of its base type: {worn} of {all}.
gear_verdict_base_tip:
You wear another item of the same base type.
Nobody finds the build's own rare or magic item again:
compare your item's mods with the build's (click the row).
gear_verdict_differs_tip: You wear another item in this slot than the build has.
gear_verdict_empty_tip: The build has an item for this slot and you wear nothing there.
gear_verdict_unknown_tip:
The plugin has not seen what you wear in this slot.
Open your inventory in the game once.
import_button_tip:
Imports the link or code typed into the field.
Pasting into the field imports by itself.
import_cancel_tip: Stops the import. Nothing is saved.
import_field_tip:
Type or paste a link here and press Enter.
A pasted link or code is imported at once.
import_file_full: The build was not saved: the saved builds would take too much space. Delete builds you no longer use and import again.
import_help:
What can be imported:
- a link from pobb.in, maxroll.gg/poe2/pob, poe2db.tw/pob or pastebin.com
- a poe.ninja link: a PoB link or a character page of the builds ladder
- a code from Path of Building (PoE2): Import/Export Build, Generate, Copy
- the XML of a Path of Building (PoE2) build
The build is saved with its trees, skills and items,
and its hints show in the game at once.
import_hint: Paste a build link or a Path of Building code
import_ok: Imported: {name}. Trees: {trees}, skill sets: {skills}, gear sets: {gear}. It is followed now: open the passive tree, the inventory or the Skills window in the game.
import_paste_tip:
Takes the link or code from the clipboard and imports it.
Copy the link or the code first, then press this.
import_problem_decode: The code was not imported: {detail}. Copy the whole code again, or paste a link to the build instead.
import_problem_download: The build was not imported: {detail}. Check your internet connection and the link, then import again.
import_problem_empty: Nothing was pasted. Copy a build link or a Path of Building code first.
import_problem_maxroll_guide: This is a Maxroll guide or planner link. Open the guide's Path of Building link (maxroll.gg/poe2/pob/...) and paste that.
import_problem_no_tree: The build has no passive tree. Export it again from Path of Building with a tree.
import_problem_not_found: The site has no build under this link. It may have expired or the link is cut off: copy the link again.
import_problem_parse: The build was not imported: {detail}. Export it again from Path of Building (PoE2) and import the new code.
import_problem_unrecognized: This is neither a build link nor a Path of Building code. Paste a link from pobb.in, poe.ninja, Maxroll, poe2db or pastebin, or a code exported from Path of Building (PoE2).
import_same: This build is already in your list as {name}: nothing was added. It is followed now: open the passive tree, the inventory or the Skills window in the game.
import_store_full: The build was not saved: the list of saved builds is full. Delete a build you no longer use and import again.
ov_gear_empty: You wear nothing in this slot
ov_gear_unknown: The plugin has not seen what you wear here yet
ov_sum_blocked: The remaining passives cannot be reached yet: refund the passives ringed in red first
ov_sum_class_differs: Your character's class or ascendancy is not the build's: follow a build made for your class
ov_sum_tree_older: The build was made for an older passive tree: passives that changed may be marked wrong
ov_sum_unknown: Passives of the build not in the plugin's tree data: {n}. Open the plugin's Diagnostics card and press Update tree data
ov_tip_adjust: Taken differently than in the build
ov_tip_ok: Already taken, as in the build
ov_tip_set_one: Take with Weapon Set I points
ov_tip_set_two: Take with Weapon Set II points
ov_tip_unreachable: Take later: it cannot be reached yet
ov_win_empty: The build has no skills for this stage.
passives_all_done: Nothing left to take: your character has every passive of this stage.
passives_attr_unassigned: Other attribute passives of the build, which name no attribute: {n}. Choose what your gear and gems need.
passives_changes_help:
Refund: passives your character has that this stage does not use.
Adjust: passives you have, but taken with another weapon set
or with another attribute than the build.
On the tree these have a red or an orange ring.
passives_choices_help:
What the build chooses where the tree gives a choice:
the attribute on "+5 to any Attribute" passives, and which passives
it takes with Weapon Set I and Weapon Set II points.
On the tree these show as small letters and I / II badges.
passives_class_differs: Your character's class or ascendancy is not the build's. The passives still compare, but the start of the tree differs: follow a build made for your class.
passives_free_steps_tip: Points this objective costs, plus steps on its way that cost no point.
passives_help:
The plan the passive tree overlay draws, as a list:
what to take next and in which order, what to refund and what to adjust.
The order is a real one: every point is next to one you already have.
passives_next_help:
The notables, keystones and jewel sockets of this stage that you still miss,
in the order to take them, with the points each costs including the way to it.
# is the step number of its first point, as drawn on the tree.
passives_no_character: Your character's passives are not known, so every passive of the stage shows as "to take". {why}
passives_no_plan: This stage has no passives the plugin's tree data knows. Open the Diagnostics card below and press Update tree data.
passives_no_tree_data: The passive tree data is not loaded, so there is no plan yet. Wait a moment; if this stays, reinstall the plugin.
passives_none_reachable: Passives are left to take, but none of them is next to a passive you have. Refund the passives marked below first, or check that the build is for your class.
passives_points: Free points: {free}. Weapon set points: I {set1}, II {set2}. Ascendancy points: {asc}.
passives_tiers_tip:
A leveling build has several trees, each for a later level.
On: what an earlier tree of the build already had is taken first,
so you follow the author's order.
Off: the cheapest objective always comes first.
passives_tree_older: This stage was made for an older version of the passive tree than the plugin's data. Passives that moved or changed may be marked wrong: ask the build's author for an updated build.
passives_unknown_ids: Passives of this stage that are not in the plugin's tree data and are left out: {n}. Open the Diagnostics card below and press Update tree data.
passives_unreachable: Passives of this stage that cannot be reached from what you have: {n}. Refund the passives marked "to refund" first.
passives_wset_caption: Weapon set passives of this stage
passives_wset_counts: Taken with Weapon Set I points: {one}. With Weapon Set II points: {two}.
save_failed_builds: Your builds could not be saved ({detail}). They stay in use until POEFixer closes, and the plugin tries again every few seconds. Check that the plugin's folder can be written to: free disk space, an antivirus, a read-only folder.
save_failed_settings: Your settings could not be saved ({detail}). They stay in use until POEFixer closes, and the plugin tries again every few seconds. Check that the plugin's folder can be written to: free disk space, an antivirus, a read-only folder.
settings_incompatible: This POEFixer version is not compatible with Build Planner; update POEFixer to use it.
skills_help:
The skills of the skill set you follow, each with its support gems.
With a character in the game the plugin marks what you already have:
tick: socketed. Arrow: you have another tier of this support.
Plus: add this support.
A chip has its gem's colour: red Strength, green Dexterity, blue Intelligence.
skills_no_set: This build has no skill set. Add skills in Path of Building and import the build again.
skills_no_supports: No support gems in the build.
skills_not_in_game: Log in with a character to see which of these skills and supports it has.
skills_problem_no_gems: The character's skill gems were not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
skills_problem_no_panel: The Skills window was not recognized, so sockets are not marked. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
skills_problem_no_player: The character's data was not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
skills_problem_not_in_game: Log in with a character to compare its skills with the build.
skills_problem_read: Reading the skills failed, probably while an area was loading. It is tried again automatically.
skills_set_empty: This skill set has no skill to show.
skills_show_granted_tip:
Also lists skills the character gets from items, passives
and the default attack, not only its own skill gems.
skills_summary: Skills of this set that your character has: {have} of {all}.
skills_support_add: Not socketed yet: add this support.
skills_support_upgrade: You have {have}: the build uses this tier.
stages_automatic_tip:
Stops following the stage you clicked and lets the plugin choose again:
by your level when the stage names carry levels,
else the first stage your character has not finished.
stages_click_hint: Click a stage to follow it whatever your level is.
stages_follow_level_tip:
Leveling builds name their trees by level, for example "Lvl 30-45".
On: the stage whose levels hold your character's level is followed.
Off: the first stage your character has not finished.
stages_gear_set_tip:
The items shown on the equipment slots and on the Gear tab.
Automatic takes the gear set the build links to the stage.
stages_help:
A Path of Building build can hold several passive trees:
the stages of leveling it. Each can have its own skill set and gear set.
The plugin follows one stage at a time.
Points: the passive points the stage's tree spends,
its ascendancy points in brackets.
stages_how_pob: the one active in Path of Building
stages_how_unfinished: the first you have not finished
stages_no_gear_sets: The build has no gear set
stages_no_skill_sets: The build has no skill set
stages_skill_set_tip:
The skills shown on the Skills window and on the Skills tab.
Automatic takes the skill set the build links to the stage.
start_more: The Passives, Gear and Skills tabs show the same as lists, also while the game is closed.
start_step_copy: Copy the link of a build from pobb.in, poe.ninja, Maxroll or poe2db, or a code exported from Path of Building (PoE2).
start_step_game: In the game open the passive tree, the inventory or the Skills window: the build's next points, items and support gems are marked there.
start_step_paste: Press Paste above. The build is imported and followed at once.
tree_bundled_ok: The passive tree data that came with the plugin is in use again.
tree_problem_mismatch: The plugin's passive tree data does not match this game version. Open the Diagnostics card and press Update tree data.
tree_problem_no_canvas: The passive tree window was found but not its content. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
tree_problem_no_data: The passive tree data is not loaded yet. Wait a moment; if this stays, reinstall the plugin.
tree_problem_no_nodes: No passive was recognized on the tree. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
tree_problem_no_panel: The passive tree window was not found in the game. If this stays after a game patch, update POEFixer and the plugin.
tree_problem_no_ui: The game's interface could not be read. Log in with a character; if this stays, restart POEFixer.
tree_problem_not_in_game: Log in with a character to see the build on the passive tree.
tree_problem_read: Reading the passive tree failed, probably while an area was loading. It is tried again automatically.
tree_update_cancelled: The download was cancelled. The data in use stays.
tree_update_demo: The demo mode does not download: the tree data in use stays.
tree_update_failed: The passive tree data was not updated ({detail}). Check your internet connection and try again; the data in use stays.
tree_update_ok: The passive tree data is updated: version {version}, {nodes} passives.
